POST /imports (which inserts and overwrites customer records by email) and GET /imports/:id have no authentication; anyone who can reach the service can overwrite customer names/phones/countries in bulk.

Each upload is buffered in memory (multer memoryStorage, up to 20 MiB) and start() launches a background job per request with no limit on concurrent or queued imports, so many parallel uploads exhaust process memory.
